item.title: GatherKit 1.1.0
item.description:
GatherKit now keeps itself up to date. It checks for a new version once a day and installs it the next time you quit. Choose GatherKit › Check for Updates… to check now, or turn automatic updates off in Settings › General.

  • The Overview shows a clearer card for your next event, and lists each thing that needs attention on its own line.
  • The event page is tidier: the status sits beside the countdown, and counts of zero are dimmed.
  • Check-in responds faster to scans and typing, and the station name is easier to find and edit.
  • Arrivals in Reports are easier to read.
  • Fixed the duplicate check in the attendee editor restarting while you typed.

If you have 1.0.0, download this version by hand once. Later versions arrive on their own.
